metadata.title: CloudTargetAssessment
metadata.description: Avaliação de segurança do seu ambiente Microsoft 365, com relatório em português e recomendações da Cloud Target.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$passwordType' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00146.ps1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.
